name: anify-gm
description: Play Engine-backed Anify adventures on Web or directly in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Play Engine-backed Anify on Web or directly in Codex.
interface.longDescription: Anify-GM runs solo or party adventures on Anify Web and as a directly installed Codex plugin. Both use the same Web wire-format output and one Engine MCP save for D20 checks, battles, inventory, equipment, character stats, quests, maps, travel, shops, and character memory.
defaultPrompt: 登录 Anify-GM 并从远程存档继续我的冒险。
和 Lynn 与 Lyra 一起开始一段新的 Anify 冒险。
查看我的角色属性、装备、背包、任务和地图。
